route: The Law on Foreigners (Zakon o strancima) and the Ministry of Interior's own text could not be reached: gov.me and mup.gov.me serve their pages by JavaScript and the PDF links are not discoverable without it. I therefore cannot quote the immigration rule. What is established from the health side is the Fund's rule: the Law on Compulsory Health Insurance art. 6 makes a foreigner with approved temporary stay an insured person only if employed, an entrepreneur, a pensioner of the Montenegrin system and so on (a closed list of ten groups); only foreigners with permanent stay who have no other basis join as a catch-all. A non-working couple on temporary stay is therefore outside the Fund and must carry private cover. Private cover for foreigners is sold under the name 'dobrovoljno zdravstveno osiguranje za strane drzavljane'.
policy: No qualifying premium found. Wiener Stadtische Montenegro sells 'Zdravstveno osiguranje stranaca': sum insured up to 10,000 EUR, treatment in public health institutions in Montenegro, repatriation up to 2,000 EUR, to age 86; conditions PDF uploaded October 2026. Generali Montenegro has a page with the same product name. Prices are given only after a quote request. No price list or tariff table was found.
working: No arithmetic: no published price. Amount left null rather than guessed.

eu_citizen_difference: EU citizens with temporary stay are also outside the Fund unless they fall in a listed group; the Fund's page notes that nationals of countries with a social-security treaty get care as the treaty provides. Not otherwise verified.
spot_check: None. Wiener and Generali Montenegro give no prices without a quote request.
uncertainty: Large. (1) The immigration rule on health cover for temporary stay was not read. Montenegrin law and practice (property, 'other grounds' or long-stay permits) are known to ask for health insurance, but I cannot quote it. (2) No premium. The products found are emergency-only with a 10,000 EUR ceiling, which may not satisfy a long-stay permit. (3) A Montenegrin-system pensioner would pay income-based contributions: not applicable to this couple. Confidence in the figure: none (null).

statutory_must_pay.what: Nothing found that this couple must pay.
